statuses.title: Statuses to extract
statuses.description: Which solicitation statuses to fetch. Verified live counts at audit time: OPEN=165, CLOSED=13026, WITHDRAWN=421, PREVIEW=0 (a valid status with no current entries).

fetchDetail.title: Fetch full detail per solicitation
fetchDetail.description: When enabled (default), fetches each solicitation's detail page for the full description, commodity codes, response contact and direct document download links. Disable for a faster, listing-only run.

maxItems.title: Max solicitations to extract
maxItems.description: Hard cap on the number of solicitations returned this run, across all selected statuses.

onlyNew.title: Delta mode - only new records since last run
onlyNew.description: When enabled, persists seen advertisementIds between runs (in this actor's own key-value store) and returns only solicitations not seen in a prior run - useful for a daily/hourly recurring monitor. Note: unlike some actors in this portfolio, MyFloridaMarketPlace's listing order is not verified newest-first (live testing found items in neither advertisementId nor publishDate order), so this does NOT short-circuit pagination for speed - it still walks up to maxItems listing items exactly like a normal run, then filters out already-seen records afterward. A run capped tightly by maxItems can therefore return fewer new records than actually exist if unseen ones sit beyond the walked window. Leave off for a full one-off extraction.

dateRange.title: Filter by recency (publishDate)
dateRange.description: Optionally restrict results to solicitations whose own publishDate (when the ad was posted to the portal) falls within this window. Independent of onlyNew.
